attchmntText: Thejo Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange'.
voiceSummary: Thejo Engineering Limited informed the National Stock Exchange that its Board of Directors reviewed a fine of Rs. 10,000 plus GST imposed for non-compliance with Regulation 44(3) of the SEBI Listing Regulations for the month ended August 31, 2026. The non-compliance arose from a technical glitch that prevented the successful registration of an XBRL filing for the Annual General Meeting voting results on the NEAPS portal. The company filed a waiver application on September 23, 2026, and attended a personal hearing before the NSE internal Committee on October 28, 2026. The outcome of the waiver application is awaited. The Board noted the issue was due to connectivity problems and directed the secretarial team to strengthen filing processes.

attchmntText: Thejo Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Thejo Engineering Limited approved its audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting was held on 11th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 31152.50 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 4782.14 lakhs. Profit for the period was 3561.30 lakhs. Earnings per share was 32.83 rupees. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 were 50849.22 lakhs. The financial results have been audited by Brahmayya & Co.
